reference.appendBehavior: Linux pwrite on O_APPEND appends at EOF without advancing the shared file cursor. The same program asserts this in CPython and Boxes.
reference.upstreamScope: This is CPython behavioral comparison at the implemented Python boundary, not execution of the full AgentOS runtime or proof of total parity.

after.fullCommand: bun run test (after build, SDK build, typecheck, Clippy and Cargo tests from bun run check; typecheck repeated after the test-only restructure)

initialFullSuiteFailure.firstFailure: Existing integration test grouped five independent fresh Python entries and hit Bun default deadline at 5002.34 ms. Bun killed two dangling processes; the next eight cases then failed ECONNREFUSED.
initialFullSuiteFailure.change: Split structured evaluation, file/global isolation and error diagnostics into three behavior-bearing tests. Preserved every original assertion and five native Python entries; ordinary five-second runner deadline unchanged. Added two sandbox setup operations. Runtime budgets unchanged.

isolatedComparison.scope: Same original test and Alchemy workerd/HTTP/R2 fixture, only the native Python Wasm asset differs. Fresh Worker per sample; no retained context crosses the engine swap. Import/export descriptors verified equal. This is not a published-runtime or production CPU/billing comparison and does not reproduce full-suite contention.
isolatedComparison.conclusion: No large latency difference demonstrated by this isolated workload; full-suite timeout cause remains limited to the observed runner deadline and secondary transport shutdown.
